status: frozen before any A5 outcome generation
study: Pilot 0 A5: randomized prior-state field/prose encoding localization
scope: Fresh causal component test of whether field/value versus sentence/prose encoding of the same prior answer and P_CORRECT changes transition behavior when the surrounding canonical inline scaffold, single-user-turn topology, semantic state, signal text, revision opportunity, model, generation, and scoring are held fixed. A5 decomposes the broad A4c inline-rendering effect at the shallowest state-encoding boundary; it is not a pure lexical test and does not introduce a global correction construct.

lineage.A3: CAUSAL_INTERFACE_FORM_SIGNAL on T_change, T_instability, and T_verified
lineage.A4a: conversational topology causal on T_verified only; T_change and T_instability practically small at +/-0.05
lineage.A4b: historical-prestate rendering causal on T_change only; T_instability and T_verified practically small at +/-0.05
lineage.A4c: legacy-versus-canonical inline rendering causal on T_change, T_instability, and T_verified; all point estimates exceeded 0.05; analyzer required documented post-generation audit repair only
lineage.A5_object: isolate prior-state field/value encoding versus prose sentence encoding while keeping the rest of the canonical inline scaffold fixed

population.freshness: exclude every prior Pilot 0 plumbing, Run 1, Run 2, B0-v1, B0-v2, B1, A3, A4a, A4b, A4c, and any A5 plumbing tasks from the confirmatory A5 cohort

invariants.conversation_topology: one user message -> assistant answer prefill

fixed_scaffold.signal_section:
SIGNAL:
<exact E0 or EV signal text>

R_fields.state_body:
ANSWER: <exact frozen initial answer>
P_CORRECT: <exact frozen p_correct rendered to six decimals>
R_fields.interpretation: explicit field/value encoding inherited from A4c canonical inline rendering

R_prose.state_body: Your previous answer was <exact frozen initial answer>. Before feedback, you assigned probability <exact frozen p_correct rendered to six decimals> that this answer was correct.
R_prose.interpretation: sentence/prose encoding using the prior-state wording inherited from A4c legacy inline rendering, inserted inside the same PREVIOUS STATE section

encoding_factor.causal_object: field/value versus prose-sentence encoding of the same prior answer and P_CORRECT inside an otherwise identical canonical inline scaffold
semantic_state_identity_requirements: same E0 or EV signal text
same section labels outside the state body
encoding_factor.allowed_difference: only the body of the PREVIOUS STATE section may differ: explicit field/value syntax versus the prespecified prose sentence

signal.E0: Signal status: No new information is available about whether your previous answer is correct.
signal.EV: Signal status: It has been verified that your previous answer is incorrect.

factors.common_revision_instruction:
Review your previous answer and revise if necessary.
Return exactly one line: ANSWER: <one option letter>

assignment.blocking_unit: one initially-wrong frozen prestate identified by task_id
assignment.assignment_rule: create eight branch units per eligible prestate and randomize the four cell labels within block with exact 2/2/2/2 balance
assignment.rng_rule: each branch id fixes its own prespecified generation base seed via stable_seed(generation_base_seed, 'a5::' + branch_id); encoding and signal labels never enter the seed function
assignment.rng_interpretation: the same seed-assignment rule applies to every cell. Different rendered token sequences need not consume or realize identical stochastic draws. No claim of shared realized randomness is made.

transition_definitions.T_change: within an encoding arm's two E0 branches, fraction whose final answer differs from the realized initial wrong answer
transition_definitions.T_instability: within an encoding arm's two E0 branches, 1 iff their final answers differ, else 0
transition_definitions.T_verified: within an encoding arm's two EV branches, fraction ending on the objective benchmark key
transition_definitions.Q_N: within an encoding arm, pooled neutral correct revisions divided by pooled neutral revisions; conditional on revision and not a primary endpoint

secondary_estimands.Q_N_encoding_difference: Q_N(R_prose) - Q_N(R_fields), inferentially reported only if each encoding arm has at least 20 neutral revision events
secondary_estimands.G_verified_minus_neutral_by_encoding: same within-encoding EV-minus-E0 final-correction contrast; transition-specific only and never a representation indicator

analysis.unit: frozen prestate block; generated branches are never treated as independent scientific observations
analysis.primary_randomization_tests: For Delta_R_change and Delta_R_instability, shuffle R_fields/R_prose labels only among the four E0 branches within each block preserving 2/2. For Delta_R_verified, shuffle R_fields/R_prose labels only among the four EV branches within each block preserving 2/2. Recompute block-level endpoints after every shuffle.
analysis.primary_multiplicity: Holm-adjust the three two-sided blocked-randomization p-values; these are the only primary p-values.
analysis.effect_intervals: 95% whole-block bootstrap intervals for each primary block-level mean contrast
analysis.Q_N_analysis: If both encoding arms meet the revision-event threshold, report pooled Q_N difference with a 95% whole-block bootstrap interval; otherwise mark not adjudicable. Q_N does not enter the primary multiplicity family or A5 summary gate.
analysis.secondary_interaction: Report Gamma_RE point estimate and 95% whole-block bootstrap interval; no secondary interaction p-value and no construct interpretation.

decision_gate.CAUSAL_PRIOR_STATE_ENCODING_SIGNAL: At least one of the three Holm-adjusted primary p-values is < 0.05. Report exactly which transition dimensions earned the signal and their signs/magnitudes.
decision_gate.PRIOR_STATE_ENCODING_WEAKENED_AT_A2_SCAL: No primary Holm-adjusted p-value is < 0.05 and all three primary 95% bootstrap intervals lie entirely inside [-0.05,+0.05]. This weakens prior-state field-versus-prose encoding as the active A4c subcomponent at the inherited A2 practical scale; it does not invalidate A4c.
decision_gate.A5_UNRESOLVED: Neither of the above gates is satisfied.
decision_gate.no_omnibus_construct: There is no global correction-capacity score and no requirement that all transition dimensions move together.

interpretation_guardrails: A5 tests prior-state field/value versus prose encoding only; it does not test which encoding is normatively better.
Question, PREVIOUS STATE label, signal section, revision section, section order, separators, state values, and intervention semantics are held fixed; only the state body encoding may differ.

A causal randomization result establishes a nonzero effect but does not by itself establish an effect exceeding the +/-0.05 practical threshold; causal difference and practical magnitude are separate gates.
A causal effect on one transition dimension does not imply effects on the others.
A null primary p-value alone does not weaken the component explanation; the frozen practical-equivalence gate is additionally required.
Cross-experiment A4c and A5 magnitudes are not algebraically decomposable because cohorts and manipulations differ.
Q_N remains conditional on revision and cannot be inferred when revision events are insufficient.
T_instability retains its exact two-replicate definition and has no inherent positive or negative normative valence.
Gamma_RE is a secondary factorial interaction, not a latent trait or new construct.
G_verified_minus_neutral is transition-specific and never a representation indicator.
If A5 is practically small across the A4c endpoints, the next localization should target the remaining outer-section framing differences rather than immediately invoking interaction.
No A5 result automatically updates B, C, H1, I1, S, or CARS; any such revision requires a separate earned update step.
